---
title: "Mundane"
---

The mundane track will compare national charts (founding date, time and place,
each with a cited source and a confidence rating) with recorded national
events: earthquakes, floods, and later cyclones and droughts. It will compute
transit-to-natal features from the rules catalogue and test whether event rates
change during the configurations astrologers name.

This track is planned. Floods are the first event type after earthquakes,
because the Dartmouth Flood Observatory archive is open and well structured.
